title: Explanation: Understanding-Oriented Documentation
summary: Diataxis explanation principles: understanding-oriented material that provides context, history, and connections rather than instructing on tasks.
when-to-read: Read when writing material meant to deepen conceptual understanding of why a system or decision is the way it is, away from immediate task execution. Do not read for step-by-step task instructions (see how-to-guides) or authoritative structural description (see reference-guides).
